data.name: The Second Date's On Us
data.headline: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third: it's a relationship.
data.benefit: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third date? That's a relationship — 15% off your first month and an extra freeze for when life gets busy.
data.rationale: Kenkere logged 3,217 leads in 12 months; only 36% reached a trial and 13.1% converted. 581 single-class sales show high drop-in, low commitment. A booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; freeze has no cash value.

scenes.title: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
scenes.narration: Renewals: Don't Ghost Us After the Party. Great party. Now the real test. 6 buyers at 7,229 rupees — 43,374 rupees. 19.5 per cent off.

data.name: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
data.headline: Great party. Now show up 8 times in May.
data.benefit: Great party. Now the real test: show up 8 times in May and your next renewal costs less — plus a 30-minute private on us.
data.rationale: 2026 anniversary-code buyers renewed at only 24.5%. Attendance in the month after purchase is the best predictor of renewal; the reward is earned by it.
data.audience: Members whose plan expires in June.
data.conditions: ≈20% effective on 3M, ≈20% on 1M with the private.
data.kpi: April cohort with 8+ May visits (target 55%); April cohort renewal at next expiry (target 55%).

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Brief the team on the 2 June offers, who each is for, the discount caps and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards.

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹2.2L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 59 new buyers (179 first visits), 14 renewals and 0 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.

steps.label: W4
steps.text: Close June: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
